# Workbench code view shows the example's authored config and children

## Context

On 2026-11-23 the operator asked for D#21480 in the Engine 14 cut, if possible. His rationale: a code inspector that by default shows only the module has no value. [D#21480's OQ7 disposition](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/discussions/21480#discussioncomment-19822656) narrows the cut to the authored record at the workbench boundary. The engine contract (options A–G, OQ1–OQ6) stays open there.

## The Problem

The workbench code view (#21144, PR #21413) prints `module` plus the configs changed since load (`ConfigurationViewport#getCodeText()`, `examples/ConfigurationViewport.mjs:332-339`). Until a visitor changes something, every example reads as one line. The tab container's stage shows three tabs at 500 × 300, and the code view shows `{module: Neo.tab.Container}` (D#21480, Measured).

## The Architectural Reality

- `ConfigurationViewport#onConstructed()` builds the example from `createExampleComponent()`. When that returns an object or a class, the viewport passes it to `Neo.create()` (`ConfigurationViewport.mjs:810-817`). Creation mutates the config object: `core.Base#setFields()` sets a non-reactive config such as `headerToolbar` directly and deletes it from the object `Neo.create()` received. So any record of it must be cloned before creation.
- At `6bce66de69`:
  - 35 workbench files return a config: the 24 fields through `StatesViewport#createExampleComponent()`, plus 11 others.
  - 40 call `Neo.create()` inside `createExampleComponent()` and return the instance.
  - `component/splitter`, `fieldWithPrefix` and `popover` build differently.
- `formatConfig#describeNonLiteralReason()` flags a function, a live instance, and any object or array that contains one. `formatExampleCode()` then replaces that whole value with one comment line. So `button/base`'s `menu`, which has a `handler` in each item, disappears whole, and so do the tab container's `listeners`. A Neo class already prints by its class name, through `formatConfigValue()`'s `NeoClass` branch.
- Design authority: D#21480's OQ7 disposition, "ship the code view narrowed to the authored record" (comment 19822656), on the operator's request. #21144's Avoided Traps already name the config object as "the unit a reader copies".

## The Fix

1. `ConfigurationViewport` keeps a structural clone of a returned config before creating it. Plain objects and arrays are copied; classes, functions and instances are kept by reference.
2. `tab/container`, `button/base` and `list/base`, the cases the criteria below name, return their config instead of calling `Neo.create()`. `Neo.create({...})` becomes `{...}`, and `Neo.create(Class, {...})` becomes `{module: Class, ...}`. The other 37 examples that create their own instance convert in #22068, in parallel. Until then they keep today's view: `module` plus changes.
3. `getCodeText()` formats the authored config, overlaid with the changed configs. The URL keeps changed configs only (#21411).
4. `formatConfig` comments out a function or live instance where it sits, inside nested objects and arrays too, instead of dropping the whole value around it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `button/base` shows `module`, `badgeText`, `flex`, `height`, `iconCls`, `text`, `ui`, `width` and the `menu` with its nested items. Its `handler`s show as commented.
- [ ] `tab/container` shows its three tabs with `header` and `html`, its `itemDefaults`, its `headerActions`, and its `headerToolbar` with the plugin's class name. It shows none of its internal toolbar, strip or body.
- [ ] `list/base` shows `displayField`, `draggable`, `store` by class name and `width`. `form/field/text` shows its field config.
- [ ] A change in the inspector replaces the authored value in the view. Reset shows the authored config again. The URL still carries changed configs only.
- [ ] The three converted examples render and behave as before, and the existing workbench specs pass.
- [ ] Unit tests cover the clone before creation and the comments inside nested values.
- [ ] No file under `src/` changes.

## Out of Scope

- Edits the inspector makes on children after build (D#21480 OQ6).
- `toJSON()`, the Neural Link and the engine contract; D#21480 stays open for them.
- Functions as code; they stay commented out.
- The other 37 conversions (#22068).

## Gold Standards Rejected

- **A `toJSON()` flag or sibling (D#21480 option A):** curated coverage gaps (`menu`, `store`, `draggable`, `headerActions`), the tab container's internal parts, and a change on cut night to an output the Neural Link reads.
- **`originalConfig`:** it drops non-reactive configs, such as the tab container's `headerToolbar`.
- **Wrapping `Neo.create()` while the example builds:** it patches a global to recover what the example can simply return.
- **The example's own source file:** #21144 already rejected it, because it shows the workbench's wiring.
